subject: Quick tablet problem
text:
Hi,

Sorry this is messy, but the volunteer sign-up tablet is acting odd again. The screen keeps freezing right after someone taps “next,” then it jumps to a blank blue page and won’t let me go back. I tried restarting it twice, unplugging it, and checking the wifi, and it only behaved for a minute before repeating.

If it happens again I’ll record a short video on my phone so you can see the exact sequence, because screenshots didn’t show the flicker at the top.

I don’t think anyone’s info is lost, but I’m worried the next shift might not save properly. Could you look when you’re free? No rush, just maybe before tomorrow evening. I already printed the backup sheet, so we’re okay for now.

Let me know if you’d rather meet near the community room or do this remotely.

Thanks so much!
